input.brief: Syllabus-aware university physics learning platform with clerk authentication and real engineering syllabus

direction.name: The printed annual
direction.idea: Lay the page out like a well-designed printed report or magazine feature: a masthead image, a tight oversized title, text held to a strict column line, and colour used in solid blocks the way a two-colour print job would. It gives weight and authority to subjects that are really about content: findings, a manifesto, a programme, a serious product. The reader should feel that someone edited this.
direction.composition: A fixed vertical axis at about 42% of the viewport width organises everything: headings begin on it, body columns hang from it, and the 0–42% zone holds small side notes, figures or stays empty. Masthead: a wide image band (photographic mosaic or a single crop) across the top 45% of the first screen; below it the title at 7–9vw starting on the axis, with a two-sentence standfirst at 20–24px. Sections alternate between text pages (title on the axis, body in one or two columns of 34–40ch to its right) and full-bleed colour pages carrying one large figure, quotation or image mosaic. Mosaics are gutterless: photographs and flat colour tiles butted together in a 4- or 6-cell grid. Page numbers, running heads and other print furniture are left out.
direction.typography: A tight heavy grotesk or a sharp serif for titles; an excellent text face for reading at 18–20px with leading near 1.5. Headings in sentence case, tracked tight.
direction.colour: Paper, ink and two or three solid block colours. A colour page is a whole section in one flat colour.
direction.imagery: Photographs used as blocks in mosaics alongside flat colour tiles; mixed subjects are fine if cropped tight and converted to one treatment.
direction.photoTreatment: Give all photographs in a mosaic one treatment: greyscale via `filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.05)`, or all full colour. Do not mix.
direction.richness: The column line, the mosaics and whole pages of colour give structure and variety without ornaments.
direction.pitfalls: The axis must be exact and reused everywhere or it reads as random indentation. Keep paragraphs to a real reading measure. On a phone the axis collapses to the left margin and side notes move inline above their paragraph.

hero.name: Narrow talk, wide headline
hero.blueprint: An asymmetric sheet on one flat paper-grey ground, divided at 34% of the width by alignment only. Left column (columns 1-4, 32px margin): the wordmark top-left; then, starting at 30% of the height, one supporting sentence at 22px with leading 1.35, max 24ch; under it the single action, a solid ink rectangle with square corners. The column's lower third is empty. Right column (columns 5-12): four text links at 15px on its top edge, the first aligned exactly to the 34% line. Beneath them the headline in a very heavy grotesk at clamp(88px, 9.8vw, 150px), two lines, line-height 0.82, tracking -0.04em, flush left on the 34% line and filling the column width. A square-cornered photograph the full width of the right column starts at 68% of the viewport height and is cropped by the bottom edge. A solid accent block 260px wide, carrying one real figure at 40px and one line of text, overlaps the photograph's top-left corner by half its own height using a negative top margin.
hero.mobile: One column on 20px margins. The wordmark and a menu word share the top row. The headline comes first at 15vw on two lines, heavy, line-height 0.85. The supporting sentence follows at 18px, then the action at full width. The photograph runs full bleed below at 4:3, with the accent block overlapping its top-left corner at 60% of the screen width.
hero.headline: A 2-4 word statement in the heaviest weight, at most 20 characters, one or two words per line.

type.note: A heavy, round old-style headline face with soft bracketed serifs over a clear transitional text serif. Suits essays, food, independent publishers and personal sites that want warmth with weight.

palette.name: Graphite and orange
palette.note: Graphite and cool light-grey sections alternate, graphite taking about two thirds, and photographs are desaturated so nothing competes. Safety orange marks the buttons, one thick solid bar across the top of the page and the highlighted item in a list or chart.

photos.note: figures, silhouettes and portraits, mostly unposed
photos.treatment: Give all photographs in a mosaic one treatment: greyscale via `filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.05)`, or all full colour. Do not mix.

motion.name: Masked headline
motion.description: On load, each line of the headline rises from behind its own baseline, about 900ms with a strong ease-out, the second line 110ms after the first; the supporting sentence and the action then fade up together. Nothing else on the page performs. Because headlines are two lines at most, you author the line breaks and wrap each line yourself. Recipe: 'Masked line reveal' in references/motion.md.

sections.name: Right-half paragraph, lone photo
sections.blueprint: No heading. On a 12-column grid with 5vw margins, one statement paragraph of 45–70 words occupies columns 7–12 only, set at clamp(24px, 2.2vw, 34px) with leading 1.25 and a first-line indent of 3em. Its top edge sits 18vh below the section top. Columns 1–6 stay empty except for a single square photograph, 20vw wide, in columns 1–3, placed so its top aligns with the paragraph's last line and it hangs below the text by most of its height. A five-line note at 14px, 180px wide, sits in columns 1–2, 96px beneath the photograph. Section padding is 160px top and bottom. Nothing is centred: the paragraph's left edge is the midpoint of the page, and later text blocks on the page may reuse that line. Holds one paragraph, one photograph and one note.
sections.mobile: The paragraph comes first at 22px, full width with 20px margins and no indent. The photograph follows at 62% width, pushed to the right margin, in a 4:5 crop instead of square. The small note sits to its left, bottom-aligned with the photograph, in the remaining 30% of the width.

sections.name: Rows with margin photographs
sections.blueprint: Everything hangs from one vertical axis at column 5, about 35% of the width. First the heading: a statement of up to five words at clamp(40px, 5vw, 80px) starting on the axis, vertically centred in an otherwise empty 70svh of ground. Then four or five benefit rows, each starting on the same axis: a title at clamp(28px, 3vw, 48px) and under it a paragraph of 34ch at 17px. Columns 1–4 stay empty. At the right margin each row carries one photograph, top-aligned with its title and deliberately unequal: 240px wide at 4:5 in one row, 320px at 3:2 in the next, 180px square after that. Rows are separated by 96–120px of space, not lines. On a saturated field, set all type in one pale ink and leave the photographs ungraded.
sections.mobile: The axis collapses to the left margin. The statement sits at 9vw in 50svh of empty ground. Each row stacks its title at 26px, the paragraph, then its photograph at alternating widths: 100%, 70% flush right, 55% flush left. 64px between rows.

sections.name: Lines that step across
sections.blueprint: The sequence is written, not counted. Four lines of display type, one stage per line, each a complete short clause that begins with its order word: 'First you send it.' 'Then we take it apart.' 'You choose one.' 'It ships on Friday.' Set at clamp(36px, 4.6vw, 76px), leading 1.0, one line each. The first line starts on column 1 and each following line starts two columns further right (grid-column-start 1, 3, 5, 7), so the block descends as a staircase and the eye follows the diagonal. Under each line, on that line's own left edge and 12px below, a sentence of up to 34ch at 17px in the soft ink. 56px between stages. The last line may take the accent colour as the single emphasis. The first line serves as the heading; there is no title above. Leave the columns to the left of the final stage empty.
sections.mobile: Lines drop to 8.4vw and may wrap onto a second line. The staircase becomes a smaller indent of 6vw per stage, so the fourth line starts 18vw in. Each sentence sits under its line at 16px on the same indent. 40px between stages.

sections.name: Portrait and offset quotation
sections.blueprint: A 12-column row on the page ground with wide margins. A portrait of the speaker, 3:4, fills columns 2–5 and is tall, about 70svh; it takes whatever mask the page gives its photographs (square corners, or the page's one motif shape). The quotation occupies columns 7–12 and starts 120px lower than the top of the portrait: four to six lines at clamp(26px, 2.6vw, 40px) in a light or regular weight, leading 1.2, measure about 26ch. The name and role sit 32px beneath the quotation at 16px, on its left edge. A second, small photograph (1:1, columns 10–11) hangs 96px below the attribution and shows the place or the thing the speaker is talking about. There is no heading. Nothing is centred; every edge lands on a column line, and the two vertical offsets are the design.
sections.mobile: The portrait runs at 72% width from the left margin, 3:4. The quotation follows at 24px, full width, starting 32px beneath. Name and role sit under it. The small second photograph sits at 44% width against the right margin, 48px lower, overlapping nothing.

sections.name: Plans as a large table
sections.blueprint: Two to four plans compared in a table whose type is far larger than a table usually gets. The first column (columns 1–4) lists what is compared, in words, at 22px. Each plan takes an equal share of columns 5–12. The header row gives each plan's name at about 3vw bold, left-aligned, with its price directly beneath at the same size in the regular weight and the period at 16px. Body rows are 22px with 20px padding; cells answer in words or numbers (“Unlimited”, “3 seats”, “Not included”), never with ticks. Every second row has a background tone one step from the ground, spanning all columns. The recommended plan is marked only by its whole column sitting on the accent tone from header to last row. The final row holds one rectangular button per plan. A two-to-four-word heading sits in the top-left cell.
sections.mobile: Plans stack as separate blocks. Each opens with the plan name and price at 9vw, then its rows as pairs: the compared item in the softer ink, the answer beneath in the full ink, both at 17px. The recommended plan's block sits on the accent tone. A full-width button ends each block.

sections.name: A band per question
sections.blueprint: Each question owns a full-bleed band, and the bands alternate between two flat tones (ground and one step away, or two palette colours with their assigned inks) and butt together with no gap. Inside every band the same grid applies: the question in columns 1–5 at 28–32px bold, top-aligned with 56px of padding above; the answer in columns 7–12 at 18px with leading 1.5, the same padding, and 56px below. Bands are as tall as their content, so their heights differ, which gives the stack its rhythm. Four to seven bands. The heading is the first band: two to four words at about 7vw on the accent colour, flush left, taller than the rest at about 40svh with the words anchored to its bottom-left. All answers are visible; there are no toggles.
sections.mobile: Bands stay full-bleed and alternate. Inside each, the question at 22px then the answer at 17px, with 32px padding top and bottom and 20px at the sides. The heading band is 30svh tall with its words at 13vw at the bottom-left.

sections.name: The idea again, inverted
sections.blueprint: The close flips the page's colours: ink becomes the ground and the ground becomes the ink, across a full-bleed field at least 90svh tall. The page's opening idea returns as a headline of three to five words at 9–11vw on two lines, leading 0.9, flush left, positioned in the upper two-thirds; it should echo the hero's wording, not repeat it. Along the bottom, on one shared baseline 40px above the edge: one supporting sentence at 20px in columns 1–5 and one rectangular button in the accent colour, right-aligned in columns 10–12, about 56px tall. Nothing else: no image, no second button, no logo. The field's top edge is a hard horizontal line where it meets the section above. If the footer follows on the same inverted field, leave 160px before it so the close still reads as its own screen.
sections.mobile: The same inverted field at 80svh. Headline at 15vw on two lines at the top. The sentence sits lower at 17px, and the button spans the full width at the bottom, 56px tall, with 20px margins. Nothing else is added.

sections.name: Columns above, wordmark below
sections.blueprint: The footer inverts ground and ink and fills a whole viewport (min-height 100svh), arranged as three rows in a grid (auto 1fr auto). Top row, 40px from the edge: four small columns on the 12-column grid (address, navigation, social, hours or contact), each a plain list at 15–16px with its first line in the full ink and the rest in the softer ink. Middle row: empty. Bottom row: the wordmark alone, sized to run from the left margin to the right margin on one line. Set it as inline SVG text with a `viewBox` fitted to the word and `width: 100%`, or tune `font-size` in `vw` to the letter count, so it never wraps; its baseline sits 20px above a single line of legal text at 13px. With `position: sticky; bottom: 0` and a lower `z-index` than the page, the last section slides away to uncover it.
sections.mobile: Columns become two by two at 15px with 32px between rows, at the top. A gap of about 20svh follows. The wordmark spans the full width at the bottom; a name longer than ten letters stacks on two lines, each fitted to the width. Legal line beneath at 12px.

references.name: Ai in Design Report 2026
references.idea: A research report laid out like a colour-blocked print annual: a thermal-blurred video collage on top, an oversized tight grotesk title, and flat orange, lilac, sage and black blocks carrying stats, quotes and chapters.
references.hero: The top 53% is a full-width video band: blurred, heat-map-like abstract footage in orange, lilac and sage, overlaid with four or five hard-edged rectangles of the same footage in grey or green, two tagged with tiny mono labels in white boxes. The header sits flush on top: a black logo block at far left, an orange link tab running to 40% of the width, two plain links at right. Below the band, on white: a two-line deck at about 1.4vw on a 1% left margin, and from 42% across a two-line title at 8.3vw, medium weight, tracking -0.06em. Bottom row: mono credit left, scroll cue and arrow aligned to the title column.
references.type: Beausite Classic, a grotesk with some stroke contrast, in Medium for titles and Regular for text; sentence case, tracking -0.06em at display size. Geist Mono for small uppercase labels. Steps: 8.3vw title, about 5.5vw numerals, about 3vw statements, 16px body, 10px mono. Footer wordmark near 96vw.
references.colour: #ffffff #000000 #fe7141 #cdabfe #d1ddd3 #f0ff1c — White base with flat blocks of orange, lilac, sage and black assigned to whole modules (stat tiles, quote panels, chapter bands), all drawn from the hero footage. Text is black, or off-white on black.
references.imagery: Hero: abstract blurred video with a heat-map grade, cut into overlapping rectangles. Body: warm documentary photos and clips of people at desks in wood-lined rooms, square-cornered, butted directly against flat colour blocks with no gap.
references.layout: 1% margins and a recurring column line at about 42% where most headings and text begin. Open white text passages ruled by hairlines alternate with tight mosaics in which photos and colour blocks share edges. Each chapter opens with a full-width colour band.

sections.description: A full-width hairline, a tiny mono label at the left, then seven black partner logos evenly spaced across the full width in one row with generous padding above and below, closed by a second hairline. Immediately beneath, another mono label and a three-line statement at about 3vw, flush left and occupying only the left half, followed by a full-width photo strip.

A mosaic with no gutters. A photo of two people at a laptop fills the left two-thirds at roughly 1:1; the right third is split into two stacked flat tiles, lilac above and sage below. Each tile carries a large numeral with a plus sign at about 5.5vw in its top-left corner and a two-line caption directly beneath; the rest of the tile is empty colour.

Quote module as two abutting blocks: a black block on the left 40% holding only a small name and a mono role caption, and a sage block on the right 60% with the quotation at about 3vw, top-left aligned with empty sage beneath. Directly below, a full-width orange band opens a chapter: hairline at top, a large two-digit number with the chapter word under it at left, a two-line title and small paragraph starting at the 42% column.

Black footer. A row of three small source counts along the top, separated by vertical hairlines, then the report name in off-white heavy type at nearly full viewport width with a trademark sign at its top-right, then the year at the same size right-aligned on a second line. Two small link columns with mono headings sit lower left beside the year; a hairline and one row of credits and partner logos close it.

steal: Start most headings and text at a fixed column line about 42% across, leaving the left for small decks, credits and chapter numbers.
Butt flat colour tiles directly against a photograph with no gutter and put one large numeral plus two caption lines in each tile's top-left corner.
Take the page's flat block colours from the hero footage so the abstract video and the layout read as one palette.
references.media: A video collage covers 100% of the screen at load and lifts to the top ~53% to uncover the title on white. Below, a documentary photograph two thirds wide in a sticky frame beside stacked colour stat blocks, a pinned deck of colour cards each with a 10s clip docked bottom-left, and a carousel of equal stills running off the right edge: 12 images and 6 muted videos, all square-cornered.
references.motion: No preloader, but the collage re-cuts itself for about 4s before the title lands. Framer drives the sticky stacking (a 1350px photo frame and three 900px chapter cards that peel away to uncover the next); there is no split text, links change colour over .2s cubic-bezier(.44,0,.56,1), and one panel slides 610px in over 500ms cubic-bezier(0.44,0,0.37,1).

references.name: The Queue
references.idea: An essay on queueing where the queue is the ornament: a line of drawn figures stands along the bottom of the hero and returns between chapters in changing period dress.
references.hero: Pinkish warm-grey page. A 12px mono breadcrumb sits top-left; there is no other navigation. The two-word title is set in a light serif at 200px (14vw), centred, its middle slightly above the viewport centre, spanning about 60% of the width with tight tracking. One centred line of grey 20px serif sits 40px beneath. The lower third stays empty until a single row of about 25 small greyscale drawn figures, each around 110px tall, stands on a hairline rule 20px above the bottom edge and runs the full width like a frieze.
references.type: Newsreader does everything: Light at 200px with -0.05em tracking for the title, regular near 30px for chapter headings, 18px body with open leading, and pale ghost numerals around 22vw. A monospace appears only in the breadcrumb and footer labels.
references.colour: #ebe4e0 #2b2622 #6f6763 #d9d2ce #16a05a — One warm rosy-grey ground throughout, brown-black text, mid-grey secondary lines, greyscale drawings. A single green appears only in the breadcrumb and one footer button.
references.imagery: Hand-drawn greyscale figures with fine outlines, standing in single file on a hairline; each band changes era costume and spacing. No boxes or backgrounds: figures sit directly on the page colour, full width.
references.layout: After the centred hero, text runs in one narrow column about 40% of the viewport wide, starting 30% from the left; the right third holds only a huge pale chapter numeral. Chapters are separated by full-width bands of figures on hairlines.

sections.description: Chapter block. A 30px serif question heads a text column about 590px wide, offset 30% from the left. Behind it in the top-right corner sits a chapter numeral roughly 22vw tall in a tint barely darker than the page, cropped by the section's top edge. Body is 18px serif at about 1.8 leading; bold run-in phrases open key paragraphs in place of subheads. No pull quotes, side notes or images inside the text.

Divider band between chapters: a full-width strip about 180px tall in which 10 to 15 drawn figures stand at uneven intervals on a 1px rule, with 120px of empty page above. The number and spacing of figures follow the story (few and scattered early, an evenly spaced orderly line later), so the divider carries part of the argument instead of acting as a spacer.

The ending switches voice. A white rounded promo bar with a blue pill button, then a heavy sans heading with a short grey paragraph and one green button, then a hairline, a mono uppercase label, and four small white cards in a row (thumbnail, mono number, bold title). It is narrower than the page and sits on a different axis from the essay column, so it reads as site furniture attached afterwards.

steal: Turn the subject into the section divider: a frieze of small figures on a hairline, redrawn for each chapter, in place of rules or spacers.
Set one serif family at three far-apart sizes (200px title, 30px heading, 18px body) and mark chapters with a pale 22vw numeral cropped off the corner.
Hold body text to a narrow column offset left of centre and leave the right third empty instead of filling it with sidebars.
